name: Rotary Club of Southport Cyril Richarde AM International Scholarship
summary: $5,000 scholarship for a continuing Griffith international student committed to community service and to supporting their home community.
who: Citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand, with preference for listed countries
Minimum GPA of 4.0 in current Griffith program
Full-time continuing student in Trimester 1 2027 with at least two trimesters remaining
how: Apply online with a statement of up to 300 words on your community involvement
